claude_md.paraphrase: A data-bearing screen shows a distinct loading message in visible text while its data loads.
An empty data-bearing screen says so in visible text, so it is not confused with loading or failure.
A failed load shows an error in visible text with a retry control and no stale figures.
A populated screen shows its data and no loading, empty or error text.
The empty User Detail screen states its emptiness in text while keeping the quota form usable.
A failed User Detail load shows its error in visible text with a retry control.
Every control on the User Detail screen is reachable and operable by keyboard, with no trap.
The focused control shows a visible indicator and is never hidden behind the sticky header.
A modal dialog takes focus on open, keeps Tab inside, and returns focus to the control that opened it.
Every form field has a programmatically associated label, and its visible label focuses the field.
An invalid field is flagged in text beside it that names the fix, and focus moves to it after a failed submit.
An irreversible change needs explicit confirmation whose safe option is the default, and Escape cancels it.
Any operation longer than one second shows a visible progress indicator within one second, and its trigger is disabled meanwhile.
A load running longer than ten seconds offers a Cancel control, and cancelling shows a visible result with a retry.
Every screen works at 320 CSS px wide with no horizontal scrolling, overlap or clipped controls.
Every screen stays usable at 200 percent zoom, with no horizontal scrolling and no clipped controls.

vision.paraphrase: The dashboard must stay readable in both light and dark themes, so text contrast must hold in each.

claude_md.paraphrase: Body text meets a 4.5 to 1 contrast ratio, and large text meets 3 to 1, in both light and dark themes.

vision.paraphrase: The dashboard must stay readable in both light and dark themes, so control boundaries and focus rings must be visible in each.

claude_md.paraphrase: Control borders and focus indicators meet a 3 to 1 contrast ratio against adjacent colors in both themes.
When the OS reduce-motion preference is set, the dialog appears instantly instead of animating.
Each screen has a unique document title that identifies the page.
Each screen has exactly one visible H1 that matches its document title.
The primary navigation marks the current page's item with aria-current.
